TilEm.js and TilEm.wasm are TilEm's core (libtilemcore, LGPLv2.1 or later) and the TI-81 program
loader from its GUI (ti81prg.c, GPLv3 or later), built from the TilEm 2.0 release
(sha256 fc27235a402dfbee35a15a5aa7c9603211ffa5a1f8b1716310ce8f0b7f4743ad):
  https://sourceforge.net/projects/tilem/files/tilem/2.0/tilem-2.0.tar.bz2
with TIde's bridge, ../tide_tilem.c, and ../config.h, by ../build.sh using the emscripten/emsdk:3.1.74 image:

  curl -L -o tilem-2.0.tar.bz2 https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/tilem/tilem/2.0/tilem-2.0.tar.bz2
  tar xjf tilem-2.0.tar.bz2
  docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/w" -w /w emscripten/emsdk:3.1.74 sh emulator/tilem/build.sh tilem-2.0 emulator/tilem/dist

TIde builds them into the app.
